title: Browser sign-in fallback is safe
description: Go: the login listener binds only to 127.0.0.1, rejects missing/wrong state and second use, stops after success or timeout, and writes mcp-session.json with mode 0600.
criterion: Go: the login listener binds only to 127.0.0.1, rejects missing/wrong state and second use, stops after success or timeout, and writes mcp-session.json with mode 0600. JS: the link return check accepts only exact http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback and http://[::1]:<port>/callback and rejects localhost names, other hosts, userinfo tricks, https, missing/privileged ports and other paths; the loopback path requires a click (never auto-redirects).
prerequisites: Go 1.27+, Node 20+ (for the web-side checks). No network, no real account: a local fake Firebase is used.
